svg.aria-label: Two ways to add a cache, compared on the resource that is already the constraint. An in-process map inside the application adds no extra service, no network hop and no new competitor for the single core. A separate cache server adds one service to run, one network round trip per lookup, and one more process contending for the same core. A small table compares them on extra services, extra hops and extra tenants on the core. The caption says a dedicated cache server is the right answer when several application servers must share one cache, and that here there is only one application server and the constraint is the very resource the extra service would also consume.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: THE OBVIOUS CACHE IS THE WRONG ONE HERE
